description: Per-jurisdiction open-data portal catalog entry attestation. R0 skeleton per ADR-2605263900 §3 (GovOpenDataSensor). Authored by `kotodama.organism.sensors.gov.gov_open_data_sensor` after passive-only fetch of an open-data CKAN/portal bulk archive (data.gov / data.gov.uk / data.gouv.fr / data.go.jp / e-Stat / data.europa.eu / govdata.de / etc.). The `stateAlignedFlag` field is set true for CN-class sources per §2(g) parallel to ADR-2605262800; downstream consumers (ossekai + manabi) MUST display the flag in derived publication. Vendor commercial gov-intel terminal imports (GovWin IQ / Bloomberg Government / Politico Pro / E&E News Pro / FiscalNote / CQ Roll Call Pro) CONSTITUTIONALLY PROHIBITED per Charter Rider §2(e)+§2(c).

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code OR supra ('EU', 'OECD', 'UN', 'WB', 'IMF').

datasetId.description: Per-portal canonical ID (CKAN package name / Eurostat dataflow code / e-Stat statsCode).

stateAlignedFlag.description: §2(g) flag — true for CN-class sources (parallel to ADR-2605262800 CN NPC handling). Downstream consumers MUST display flag in any derived publication.
